mapper.select:
select tr.id, tr.name, tm.id as membersId, tm.member_name, tm.create_user_id, tm.create_user_name, tm.create_time, tm.template_id, trrm.id as roleRefMembersId from template_role tr left join template_role_ref_members trrm on tr.id = trrm.role_id and tr.template_id = trrm.template_id left join template_members tm on trrm.members_id = tm.id and tm.template_id = trrm.template_id
and tr.name like concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword} ,'%')
and tr.template_id like concat('%', #{params.templateId} ,'%')
ORDER BY tr.create_time DESC
